fields.description: Chevalia Estate is a five bedroom villa collection on the edge of Grand Polo Club & Resort’s Green Core. The central polo landscape shapes the setting, with a clubhouse, stables and green routes in the wider estate. Two distinct villa size groups appear in the official plans, each with its own layout and outdoor-space allocation.

overview: Chevalia Estate’s brochure describes homes arranged around the central green and an equestrian clubhouse with a covered spectator terrace. Landscape routes and sports facilities provide other ways to use the estate. The interior direction favours polished marble and natural light. Membership, event access and final material schedules should be checked rather than inferred from that design description.
research.locationNote: Chevalia Estate sits beside the Green Core within Grand Polo Club & Resort, Dubai. The brochure map places the estate in relation to The Oasis, Expo City and Al Maktoum International Airport. Individual plots have different outlooks; published journey estimates and illustrated views need a unit-level check.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises Chevalia Estate from AED 9 million, matching its launch fact sheet. This published figure is not a current reservation offer; obtain a written quotation for the chosen villa.
research.paymentNote: The launch document provides 10% at booking, seven later 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. It is a historical schedule, with some dates already passed; current payment obligations must be checked against the unit’s agreement.
research.handoverNote: February 2029 is the estimated construction-completion month in the project’s payment sheet and is corroborated by Property Finder. It is not a guarantee of key handover or a verified construction-progress update.

facts.label: Launch collection and plots
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 80 five bedroom villas, averaging 6,516 sq ft built-up area and 7,490 sq ft plot area. These are collection averages, not individual dimensions or current availability.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: A-type suites measure 6,640.79–6,648.65 sq ft; B-type suites measure 3,881.57–3,891.37 sq ft. Published totals add balcony and carport space.

facts.label: A-type arrangement
facts.value: The drawings include ground, first and second levels, a lift, staff rooms, a separate working kitchen, roof lounge and study. A pool and sunken seating are shown; final inclusion depends on the specification.

facts.label: B-type arrangement
facts.value: The smaller B layouts also show a lift and maid’s room, with a guest bedroom at ground level and another bedroom, study and terrace on the second level.
